name: Rohan Abeyaratne
researchFocus: Theoretical and applied mechanics, including nonlinear continuum mechanics, finite elasticity and plasticity, and material instabilities and stress-induced phase transformations in solids.
title: Quentin Berg Professor of Mechanics

name: A. John Hart
researchFocus: Manufacturing processes, machine design, and integration of computing and automation in production systems, including additive manufacturing and nanostructured materials.
title: Class of 1922 Professor of Mechanical Engineering

name: Ali Mani
researchFocus: Large-scale high-fidelity numerical simulations and applied mathematics to understand transport processes strongly coupled with fluid flow, including turbulence and chaos.
title: Professor of Mechanical Engineering

name: Mark Cutkosky
researchFocus: Design and control of robotic hands, tactile sensors and devices for human/computer interaction, with manufacturing work on design tools for rapid prototyping; he supervises multiple doctoral students.
title: Fletcher Jones Professor in the School of Engineering

name: David Cebon
researchFocus: Mechanical, civil and materials aspects of road transport engineering, including heavy vehicle dynamics, advanced suspension design, vehicle safety, fuel consumption and decarbonisation.
title: Professor of Mechanical Engineering

name: Hugh Hunt
researchFocus: Engineering dynamics and vibration, including control of vibration from underground railways, gyroscopes and boomerangs, renewable energy and climate repair.
title: Professor of Engineering Dynamics and Vibration

name: Daniele Dini
researchFocus: Tribology, applied mechanics and materials, centred on advanced modelling of tribological systems and interfaces across scales; he heads the Imperial Tribology Group and invites PhD applications at any time.
title: Professor of Tribology

name: Pavlos Aleiferis
researchFocus: Fundamentals of fluid mechanics with applications in advanced zero/low-carbon energy and propulsion systems, using laser-based optical diagnostics combined with validated CFD modelling.
title: Chair in Thermofluids

name: Karsten Stahl
researchFocus: Mechanical drive systems, including gears, synchronizers, multi-disc clutches, rolling bearings and electromechanical drive systems; director of the Gear Research Center (FZG) and Head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering.
title: Professor of Mechanical Engineering (Chair of Machine Elements)

name: Wolfgang Polifke
researchFocus: Thermo-acoustic instabilities, combustion, gas turbines, reacting and turbulent multiphase flows, acoustics, and data-based reduced-order models.
title: Professor of Thermofluid Dynamics

name: Michael Brear
researchFocus: Technical, economic and environmental analysis of transport and energy systems, combustion of conventional and alternative fuels, and stationary and mobile power plants with engines, turbines, energy storage and renewables.
title: Professor of Mechanical Engineering

name: Katja Hölttä-Otto
researchFocus: Engineering design theory and methodology, including user-centred design, design for circular economy, modularity, creativity and complex system design; Head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering.
title: Professor of Engineering Design

name: Shawn Kook
researchFocus: Directs the UNSW Engine Research Laboratory, investigating new powertrain technologies for carbon-neutral fuel combustion, including hydrogen, ethanol, methanol and biodiesel, using optical and laser-based imaging diagnostics.
title: Professor of Mechanical Engineering

name: Ang Liu
researchFocus: Engineering design, intelligent manufacturing, digital twins and artificial intelligence, with a particular interest in data- and AI-driven approaches to design and manufacturing.
title: Professor of Engineering Design

name: Nasser Ashgriz
researchFocus: Fluid and thermal systems, spray and multiphase flows, including droplet collision and breakup, fuel injectors, energy, combustion and microfluidics.
title: Professor of Mechanical & Industrial Engineering

name: Aimy Bazylak
researchFocus: Canada Research Chair (Tier 1) in Clean Energy; multiphase flow through porous media and thermofluids for clean energy, including PEM fuel cells, PEM water electrolyzers and CO2 electrolyzers.
title: Professor of Mechanical & Industrial Engineering
